title: auto-review.yml applies only collaborator review comments, through a claude.yml-shaped tool list, and cannot approve

criteria.given: auto-review.yml collects the PR's reviews and inline review comments
criteria.then: both gh api collection queries filter on author_association in (OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR), so comments from users without write access never reach the prompt

criteria.given: the Claude step of auto-review.yml runs
criteria.then: the checkout does not persist credentials, the step carries no GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, and --allowed-tools names no bare Read/Edit/Write and no git diff/log/push; edits and reads stay workspace-scoped and the narrowed git set matches claude.yml (status, add, commit), with git push and .github/ edits disallowed
requests pull-requests: read (never write, so it cannot approve) and pushes the review commit from a step of its own after the model run, not through a model-callable git push
a workflow-shape test pins the collaborator filter and the tool list so the properties are guarded by ci / flake-policy tests
